verdict.rationale: Docs show users can prompt in plain language to "analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs" (codegen-docs-1), and agents respond by presenting a structured plan with each implementation step (codegen-docs-22) before creating PRs (codegen-docs-24) or tasks (codegen-docs-28), matching the intent-to-spec flow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of scoping accuracy, and more detail on how ambiguous requirements are clarified or broken into sub-tasks beyond the single plan-presentation feature.
